Alaska Division of Elections — ENRbyPrecinct.csv
================================================

Source file (trimmed): https://www.elections.alaska.gov/results/24GENR/ENRbyPrecinct.csv
Recorded: 2026-10-27, from the 2024 general election results folder (24GENR).

Trimmed for the fixture: only six contests are kept (U.S. President / Vice
President, U.S. Representative, House District 1, Senate District B, BM#1 -
23AMLS, Supreme Court - Borghesan) and only the first eight precincts (Pct_Id)
of each, with the original header row and column order unchanged. Totals in the
tests are therefore fixture-local, not the real statewide totals.

The full file is ~21.7k rows; summing `total_votes` over every row of a contest
reproduces the Division's published statewide totals (checked for U.S.
Representative: 159,550 Begich / 152,828 Peltola / 13,010 Howe / 3,417 Hafner).
